collection.description: A huge cloud of fruit bats has settled on the noni bushes near the encampment.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A huge cloud of fruit bats has settled on the noni bushes near the encampment. (name1) has never seen so many in (his/her) life.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text:
(name1) lies on (his/her) back under the bushes all evening, watching the bats come and go. By the end of it (he/she) can tell three kinds apart.
The Heathens' village learns more about farming. \(no effect\)

text_only.reason: the owner's flavor rule (2026-11-23): only Heathens are in this event, so the Heathens' village's food is story text only -- the game is not changed, and the draft's line ends "(no effect)"

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) runs at the bushes, flapping (his/her) arms. The bats leave in a great rushing cloud. So, for a while, does (name1)'s hearing.
